notes.title: Patch Notes January 1, 2025
notes.content:
This patch should address the issue where the narration stops working.
This will also fix some bugs with the leaderboards (hopefully).

notes.title: Leaderboard Testing!
notes.content:
There are two changes in the latest build:
-Steam leaderboard have been integrated. I'll be testing to see if it works.
-The leaderboard workflow has been adjusted. You'll see the best 16 times on the leaderboard at the end of each level.
